items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured hamstring at Wednesday practice; doctors do not believe it is serious, but Week 2 status vs Bengals is in jeopardy.
items.why: Hamstring injury in practice; history of missing 5 games in 2024 with hammy; limited Wednesday.
items.implication: High-end WR2 jeopardy; plan without him Week 2; long-term outlook positive if minor.
items.opportunity: Routes: 37 of 42 Stroud dropbacks Week 1; Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27 next.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out at least 4 games.
items.why: Wrist fracture/surgery to quicken recovery; injured Week 1.
items.implication: Rookie hyped camp star sidelined until ~Week 6; Ravens WR depth thin with Flowers also dinged.

items.text: A.J. Brown placed on IR with high-ankle sprain; miss ~4-6 weeks (earliest Week 6). Beneficiaries Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas.
items.implication: NE WR room opens; Doubs/Douglas waiver priority.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) day-to-day, DNP Wednesday after aggravating in Week 1; status uncertain for Week 2 vs Saints. Lane already IR.
items.why: Aggravated preseason hamstring; 5-150-1 before exiting Week 1; not considered serious initially.
items.implication: If OUT, Bateman and others elevate; Lamar target share opens.

items.text: Kenneth Walker #1 RB in fantasy within range of outcomes; full-grown-man love post-MNF debut.
items.why: Preseason projection realized in workhorse role + receiving involvement.
items.implication: Start with confidence; ROS elite upside.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant Wednesday; indication could return Sunday vs Steelers.
items.why: Full practice after missing Week 1 ankle; positive ramp.
items.implication: Likely RB2/flex behind Stevenson; committee possible.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday but expects to play Sunday vs Texans; mental reps.
items.implication: Monitor Thu/Fri practice; likely full go, minimal fantasy ding if plays.

items.text: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold ruled out Week 2 vs Cardinals (glute); no plans for IR.
items.why: Glute injury; early rule-out but keep active roster.
items.implication: Drew Lock likely starts; streamer option per ETR.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top Week 2 waiver wire target after Stribling injury; solid Week 1 usage.
items.why: Stribling out long-term opens targets/routes; Deebo looked like old self.
items.implication: Priority add; flex/WR3 upside with CMC workload management.

items.text: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling IR ankle surgery, miss ~10 weeks. Beneficiaries Deebo Samuel, Demarcus Robinson. Berry top waiver Deebo.
items.implication: Deebo role expansion (already solid Week 1 target/RZ share); top waiver.
items.opportunity: Deebo 21% tgt share + RZ in Week 1.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes/33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. He fucks.
items.why: Handled nearly all early RB work + high routes/targets as designed.
items.implication: Elite RB1 range; handcuff valuable; #1 RB outcomes possible.

items.text: First ROS rankings live: CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty among top discussed with opportunity adjustments.
items.implication: Hold/buy low on these; Etienne/Rice/Jeanty elevated roles.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey DNP Wednesday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor; DEN RB committee impact if sits; J.K. Dobbins etc. elevate.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after torn MCL surgery.
items.implication: SF TE depth hit; Kittle primary, Stoll/Hodge adds.
